LanguageData.Riimba.UnitNoStation: No control station - looking for one to sign on to.
LanguageData.Riimba.UnitStationUnpowered: Its control station has no power. Parked until it does.
LanguageData.Riimba.UnitFlat: Flat. Charging slowly off its station's field.
LanguageData.Riimba.AssignStationDesc: Pick which control station commands this unit. It will drive there and sign on, taking one of that station's slots.
LanguageData.Riimba.SignOffDesc: Release this unit from its station, freeing the slot. It will stop cleaning and look for another station to sign on to.
LanguageData.Riimba.StationFull: {0} already has all {1} of its slots filled. Sign a unit off it first.
LanguageData.Riimba.StationNoPower: Unpowered - every unit signed on to it is parked.
LanguageData.Riimba.StationLegend: Cyan spots: docking bays. Orange spot: waste out.
LanguageData.Riimba.WasteBacklog: Waste backed up - clear the output spot. Units cannot unload until it drains.
LanguageData.Riimba.DumpWasteDesc: Put the part-filled waste out now instead of waiting for it to reach a whole item. Rounds up and deducts the full amount, so dumping early is borrowed against later cleaning rather than free.
